title: No faithful primitive original-circle carrier intertwines onto the complete spherical carrier

intertwiner_obstruction.target_support: The original C action on H_ps has only even integer weights and kernel {1,z}.
intertwiner_obstruction.primitive_source: A faithful primitive U(1) carrier has weight lattice of gcd one and therefore contains at least one odd charge after either sign automorphism.
intertwiner_obstruction.automorphisms: The only circle automorphisms have degree plus_or_minus one, so they preserve charge parity.
intertwiner_obstruction.weight_space_law: For a linear C-intertwiner J, a source weight-r vector maps into target weight plus_or_minus r under an automorphism of degree plus_or_minus one.
intertwiner_obstruction.obstruction: Every odd source weight maps to zero because H_ps has no odd target weight. Hence no injective or faithful complete-carrier intertwiner exists from a primitive original-circle carrier onto H_ps.
intertwiner_obstruction.scope: This excludes the stated linear domain-preserving original-circle automorphism route. It does not exclude passage to an effective quotient, another circle, nonlinear or nonlocal observation, or a source-owned reduction.

claim_ceiling: The complete K1356 spherical carrier cannot be the faithful image of a primitive charge carrier through a linear intertwiner and an automorphism of the original circle. The result is an internal global-group obstruction, not a falsification of source hypercharge or of nonlinear, quotient, or differently selected reductions.
